Hi Ellen / Samir —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, Consortium is ready to move forward with a 12-month pilot (start: Dec 1) but finance asked for two items before signature:

- Quarterly invoicing (one invoice per quarter)
- Net-90 payment terms for the first two quarters while they clear internal approvals

Marissa —

Looping you in for exec consent. Aditya flagged that Consortium is a strategic health-care pilot (expected expansion in H2). They're requesting: quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for first two quarters. They offered to sign the SOW with an up-front commitment and to provide an AP contact for ACH.

Risks/mitigations I see:
- Credit exposure (~$180k over two quarters)
- We can require PO and set invoice calendar lock; optionally request a small advance (10% of first quarter) or a short-term credit hold if payments slip

Recommended motion: conditional approval for Net-90 for Q1–Q2 only, with an invoice calendar, PO on file, and a 10% advance or an explicit collections trigger (30 days late -> suspend). Also propose a 1.5% revenue protection credit if late beyond 120 days (recoverable).

Need your signoff or alternate guidance. If we approve, I will draft an amendment to the SOW and coordinate with Legal to include the calendar and triggers.

— Jonas

Thanks for the summary, Jonas.

I understand the strategic value here and am willing to approve the conditional terms with the following firm conditions:

1) Net-90 limited to Q1 and Q2 of the pilot only.
2) Consortium must provide a PO and AP contact before the first invoice is issued.
3) Redwood to receive 10% of the total contract value as an advance (applied to Q1 invoice). If the customer refuses advance, require ACH setup and a signed collections SLA.
4) Add explicit suspension trigger: unpaid invoices >30 days after due date -> suspend provisioning for new endpoints; unpaid >60 days -> suspend all non-critical provisioning until remedied.
5) No discount beyond the already-offered 12% pilot discount without separate approval.

If those conditions are acceptable we approve; Jonas, please draft the SOW amendment language and get Legal to insert the calendar + triggers into the payment terms. Aditya, please confirm with Consortium that these conditions are acceptable and proceed to get PO+advance ASAP.

Marissa Cole
